decisions.canonical_rule: TypedWitness_C is a semantic witness abstraction. Trace certificates, Lean proof terms, and executable artifacts are representations of that witness rather than the witness itself.
decisions.supporting_evidence: Notebook 18-20 use trace metadata, while P125-P126 point toward a constructive proof system.
decisions.consequences: Allows Lean proof terms and execution traces to be treated as concrete representations of the same underlying abstract semantic witness.

decisions.canonical_rule: TraceCompatible_C is explicitly indexed by context C.
decisions.supporting_evidence: Candidate MD note declares it context-dependent via index C.
decisions.consequences: Enforces context-dependent trace compatibility boundaries, allowing context-specific optimization.
